label: Reuse the original Timaeus broad/distinct cause predicates without revising their source readings
summary: Reuse the original Timaeus broad/distinct cause predicates without revising their source readings. Under explicit decidable identity, all three obligations certify the named local delta: a generated self-causing entity has a distinct alternative cause. Reconstruction keeps the broad witness when it is distinct; if it is self-identical, D supplies an alternative witness whose distinctness and causation concern that same alternative. A Bool identity-only setting satisfies broad and not distinct; an all-pairs setting admits self-causation and D; an empty-cause setting has D without broad. Global irreflexivity was rejected as too strong. D is not claimed unique or minimal; no causal applicability or root premise is discharged. PR #723 order-like causal primitives supply no ordinary-order identities merely by their names. A separate generated-self-only plus generated-uncaused two-point control makes W → S true and D false, excluding a disguised conditional restatement.
